tools.notes: Adds an item to the logged-in account's per-store cart through the site's UpdateCartItemsMutation, increasing the quantity if the item is already there; checks availability and the item's min/max/increment first; one mutation per invocation, never retried. The source before the 2026-09-28 change was live-verified 2026-09-25 (author and independent QA): per-each and weighed items, increments, unavailable item, wrong-location id, quantity-rule rejections, restored cart. Unverified: throttling and site rejections other than the unknown-item case. Items carry package_string, pack_count and unit_size from the site's package line (size alone is per unit for multipacks); added 2026-09-28, author live check passed, awaiting independent QA. Since 2026-09-28 the shopping location comes from the site's GetLastUserLocation query (or a fresh /store render when it has no address), never from the page's load-time state, and a failed location read fails the call; the tool follows an address switch without a reload. Author live check passed, awaiting independent QA.

kind page, read-only: reports challenge_pending, registered, existing_account or nothing_pending for the current tab from the page and the site's current-user data; never submits or navigates. Live-checked read-only on a signed-out /signup page (nothing_pending). Draft until a real sign-up exercises the pending and registered states.

First-page product search in one store through the site's SearchResultsPlacements query, hydrated with Items; exact matches first, related on request or when there are none. Sends the literal query (the site's reformulation is off) unless allow_reformulation is set, because the site otherwise respells brand names and still labels the results as exact. Items carry package_string, pack_count and unit_size from the site's package line (size alone is per unit for multipacks). Changed 2026-09-28: author live check passed; awaiting independent QA. Requires a logged-in session with a saved address. Author live check passed, awaiting independent QA.

Page tool. Makes one saved payment method the one checkout charges, via InitializeCheckout for a store's non-empty cart (a POST that opens a session and places nothing), UpdateBuyflowPaymentInstructionsV2 and UpdateCheckout; succeeds only when the refreshed checkout session and the account list both show the method. The choice is account-wide. Refuses split-tender checkouts, disabled and expired methods; no-op when already selected; never places an order or edits methods; never retries. Author live check 2026-09-28 (switch and restore); awaiting independent QA.

Page tool. Switches the session to one saved address through UpdateUserLocation (the header picker's request); unknown ids are rejected and an already-selected address sends nothing; one mutation, never retried. Does not create, edit or delete addresses. Author live check 2026-09-28: switch, same-page follow-through by list_stores and search, and restore; awaiting independent QA.

Sets a cart line to an exact quantity (0 removes) through the site's UpdateCartItemsMutation; not_in_cart when the item is absent; one mutation per invocation, never retried. Live-verified 2026-09-25 (author and independent QA) with per-each and weighed items and a fully restored cart. Since 2026-09-28 the shopping location comes from the site's GetLastUserLocation query (or a fresh /store render when it has no address), never from the page's load-time state, and a failed location read fails the call; the tool follows an address switch without a reload. Author live check passed, awaiting independent QA.

Independent search/parser QA passed; domain migration live-verified from /travel-agents. Returns initial outbound cards only, including round trips; 1–7 adults; displayed cash fares are not trip totals. Inventory failures remain explicit errors.

Independent QA verified a new line, incrementing an existing line by id, unavailable and not_found refusals without writes, and not_authenticated when signed out, all on a real signed-in cart that was restored afterwards. quantity_limit and adding a UPC that only exists as a saved-for-later line are fixture-tested only.

Independent QA verified the active-cart read with priced lines, saved-for-later separation, subtotal, not_authenticated when signed out, and restoration checks before and after cart mutations; degraded output when the product lookup fails is fixture-tested only.

Independent QA verified lookups by UPC, zero-padding, not_found for unknown codes and the unpriced placeholder record (returned ok with available false), signed out and signed in. Prices and availability are for the session's selected store and fulfillment method only.

Three independent failure-path QA passes (agt_b45e69419d64ca15c913, agt_2abe214c89e45307dfec, agt_81701554c70a9f25b7e6) found no blockers; their findings (110-second budget, entry_path on failures, README snippet, timeout wording) were fixed and re-checked, the last pass on this exact source without submissions. Author-verified live with one residential stealth browser: DuckDuckGo entry to the login.kroger.com form, fabricated submissions returning invalid_credentials with the site's text, one real submission returning authenticated (no MFA), and the already-signed-in path with the account email confirmed from the customer data token plus an account-mismatch refusal. Unverified: MFA/otp mode, lockout, CAPTCHA, wrong password for an existing account, other proxy configurations.

Independent QA (three passes, the last on this exact source) verified first-page results, ordering against the site's own results page (organic order identical; the site's interleaved sponsored placements are returned in place and flagged), limits, fuzzy no-match behaviour, signed-out use in a fresh browser, header-capture caching and the schema gate. Author-verified live signed in. First page only; a nonsense query returns fuzzy matches rather than no_results.

Independent QA verified setting an absolute quantity, removal with quantity 0, not_in_cart for absent lines and for saved-for-later lines (left untouched), and not_authenticated when signed out, on a real signed-in cart that was restored afterwards. quantity_limit is fixture-tested only.
